name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Success | Client Onboarding, Account Health & Cross-Functional Coordination
summary: Customer success professional who keeps a large caseload on track without letting follow-ups slip. At Wix I carried up to ~25 active onboardings at once while launching 25+ clients a month at 110% of implementation targets. At Birdeye I managed 15-20 partners, including agencies serving healthcare clients, and kept all but one by watching account health and stepping in early.

experience.title: Client Success & Operations Lead — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own client relationships end to end, coordinating onboarding meetings, tracking documentation and action items, and keeping every timeline and deliverable on record in GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion.
Set up and validate client system configurations and data imports, re-checking every import for accuracy.
Troubleshoot integrations and access credentials (OAuth, API keys) directly and document platform details for each client.
Build reporting and dashboards that organize client data for regular review meetings.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners across health, home services, and retail, including agencies focused on healthcare clients, retaining all but one (~94%).
Analyzed partner utilization to spot at-risk accounts early and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, and fed structured feedback to Product and Engineering.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, managing workflows and tasks in ClickUp.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 110% of implementation targets, and managed a high-value portfolio that saw 25% conversion improvement across supported accounts.
Led onboarding teams of up to 30 specialists, running weekly training and 1:1 coaching.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Advised clients on CRM adoption and guided onboarding and workflow design, building relationships with C-suite executives.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
